data.name: 也可以透過共用 Collector：應用使用該信任範圍的 Collector 入口憑證，Collector 再以對應的 Vigiloom 來源憑證傳送。這兩種憑證不同，不能互換。
data.value: Alternatively, use a shared Collector: the application uses the Collector ingress credential for its trust boundary, and the Collector sends data using the corresponding Vigiloom source credential. These credentials are different and cannot be interchanged.

data.value: After an application starts reporting, unapproved services with signals in the last three minutes appear in the pending list. Observation data is retained only after administrator approval; earlier data is not backfilled.

data.value: After approval, keep the application processing requests, then check last received times, logs and traces in service details. Trace availability depends on the application sampling configuration.

data.name: Health Checks 與 OTLP 是不同訊號：應用需提供可由中央平台到達的健康端點，管理員先允許必要的目的網段，再為已核准服務設定端點與檢查頻率。如需確認資料庫等相依服務，應用端須另外註冊對應檢查。
data.value: Health Checks and OTLP are separate signals. The application must expose a health endpoint reachable by the central platform; an administrator must allow the destination network and configure the endpoint and frequency for the approved service. Checks for databases and other dependencies must be registered separately.

data.name: 狀態過期、沒有檢查或停止收集都不會自動顯示正常；健康結果不由主機 Ping 或 Collector 連線推定。
data.value: Expired status, missing checks or stopped collection do not automatically mean healthy. Health is not inferred from host Ping or Collector connectivity.
